newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shandong Construction '96 net up 1.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Shandong Construction '96 net up 1.8 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures):
Earnings per share 0.24 yuan vs 0.23 yuan
Net assets per share 2.09 yuan vs 1.85 yuan
Company name: Shandong Shantui Construction Machinery Co Ltd.
Note: the results were published in a company statement in Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Wednesday. All figures are based on Chinese accounting standards.
The company, based in the city of Jining in eastern Shandong province, listed 88.60 million A shares in Shenzhen on December 27, 1996.
The company's board of directors proposed to make a two-for-10 bonus issue, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting scheduled for May 8, the company statement said.
